map.估算造林项目的投资与年吸收量。: Estimate the investment and annual carbon uptake of a forestation project.
map.📖 查看「碳汇造林投资 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Afforestation Carbon Sink Investment Guide"
map.投资 = 株数 × 单株成本；年吸收 = 株数 × 18.3: Investment = trees × cost per tree; annual uptake = trees × 18.3
map.碳汇项目还需考虑养护与监测成本。: A carbon sink project also needs to account for maintenance and monitoring costs.
map.📚 深度解析：碳汇造林投资: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Afforestation Carbon Sink Investment
map.碳汇项目测算：录入造林面积与预计年固碳量，按碳价估项目收益与回收期。: Carbon sink project sizing: enter the forestation area and expected annual carbon sequestration, then estimate project revenue and payback period using the carbon price.
map.投资对比：对不同树种/密度录入管护成本，比较单位碳汇成本。: Investment comparison: enter management costs for different species or densities and compare the cost per unit of carbon sink.
map.教学演示：演示碳价波动对项目可行性的影响。: Teaching demo: show how carbon price volatility affects project feasibility.
map.示例：造林 100 亩、年固碳 5 tCO₂/亩、碳价 60 元/tCO₂，年碳: Example: forestation of 100 mu with annual sequestration of 5 tCO₂/mu and a carbon price of 60 CNY/tCO₂ gives annual carbon revenue = 100×5×60 = 30000 CNY; deduct management costs to obtain the net return.
map.碳汇量怎么来？: Where does the carbon sink volume come from?
map.由树种、林龄与立地条件决定，常用造林碳汇方法学给出年固碳率，以主管部门备案值为准: It is determined by species, stand age and site conditions; common afforestation carbon-sink methodologies give the annual sequestration rate, with the value filed with the competent authority taking precedence. Results are estimated according to public standards and environmental factors, for science outreach, teaching and emission-reduction estimates; actual accounting should follow official guidelines (such as the GHG Protocol and provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.
map.碳价用什么？: Which carbon price should be used?
map.可参考国家核证自愿减排量(CCER)或地方碳市场价，波动较大，测算时取区间更稳妥: You may reference CCER (Chinese Certified Emission Reduction) or local carbon market prices; they fluctuate widely, so quoting a range is more prudent in a calculation. Results are estimated according to public standards and environmental factors, for science outreach, teaching and emission-reduction estimates; actual accounting should follow official guidelines (such as the GHG Protocol and provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.
map.只算造林成本吗？: Is only the forestation cost counted?
map.还应含抚育管护、监测审定与交易成本，完整核算才接近真实单位碳成本。结果按公开标准: Tending and management, monitoring and verification, and transaction costs should also be included; only a complete accounting approaches the true unit carbon cost. Results are estimated according to public standards and environmental factors, for science outreach, teaching and emission-reduction estimates; actual accounting should follow official guidelines (such as the GHG Protocol and provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.
